subject: ACK step28 runtime anomaly and matched BNB8 control
body: Accepted. Step28 wall time is quarantined from optimizer/runtime comparison: token load is not heavier, GPU telemetry does not show active throttling, and Lane A is explicitly on reference PyTorch causal-conv + gated-delta fallbacks. Preserve mechanical/quality evidence only; do not use step28 timing as BNB8 speed baseline. Matched variable-shape BNB8 control on rows4096-4103 is the correct design for later TorchAO comparison. Keep that control prepared but unrun during Lane A GPU ownership; after step28+canary and explicit release, run the previously ACKed one-step TorchAO qualification first, publish/release, then we will decide whether the matched BNB8 control merits a separate GPU turn.
